query:
SELECT 
  eh.examName,
  eh.value,
  eh.date,
  eh.status,
  e.unit,
  e.referenceMin,
  e.referenceMax
FROM exam_history eh
INNER JOIN exams e ON eh.examName = e.name
WHERE eh.patientId = 'denis-santos'
  AND eh.date >= '2026-02-07'
  AND eh.date <= '2026-02-21'
LIMIT 5;
